profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit open-source foundation that develops and maintains Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software. The software covers a broad range of production tasks including 3D modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil drawing, and VFX work. Blender 5.2 LTS is the current highlighted release, bringing features such as a Cycles Texture Cache for more memory-efficient rendering of scenes with many image textures, new Grease Pencil texture brushes, and an Online Essentials Asset Library with procedural material support. The foundation also operates Blender Studio, which produces short films and feature films using the software, with a project called OVERGROWN recently announced publicly.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons as a product category, described as third-party 3D creation plugins that run locally and are open-source, with model provenance varying by plugin. Blender's Python API and add-on ecosystem support a wide community of developers building extensions, which the company describes as an ever-expanding ecosystem of tutorial makers, content creators, add-on developers, and global marketplaces. Blender is a member of the Academy Software Foundation, the Khronos Group, the Linux Foundation, and the Open Invention Network, and the site notes hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts.
